name: qoresence-observatory
description: Pull-only observatory connector for personal agents (Muse first). One read tool — get_observation — plus closed refuse_* tools. The agent asks about the session; it never takes the pad, never publishes, and never sees score digits.
hard_laws: pull-only — never opens capture, never touches DualSense/pad
licenses_digits=false forever — never mints or echoes score digits
localhost 127.0.0.1 only — no LAN, no hosted HDMI proxy
default OFF / opt-in — QORESENCE_OCCF=1 or --occf; --play never enables
fail-closed blanks when board unlocked, recap empty, or no observation
no marketplace / directory publish; no get_timeline / export_presence_pack in v0
